## Context

Describe the problem and reference the task or user story.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and any important tradeoffs.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Explain any checks not applicable.

## Risks

Describe known limitations, migration needs, or operational impact.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed and documentation is current.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data are included.
- [ ] Authorization and edge cases were reviewed where applicable.
